# AgentKit Drawer

> Tested rules packs and prompt templates that keep AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf) on track for a specific stack. One-time purchase, instant download, use in unlimited personal and commercial projects, 14-day refund.

Support: agentkitdrawer@agentmail.to. Free samples are MIT-licensed on GitHub: https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer

## Packs
- [Vibe Starter Rules Pack](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drawers) (DRW-01, $19): Rules for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) on Next.js App Router + Supabase + Stripe: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, 8 scoped .cursor/rules (auth, RLS, Stripe webhooks, env/secrets, tests, UI), 12 slash-command prompts, 2 launch checklists.
- [Game Jam Agent Kit](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drawers) (DRW-02, $24): AGENTS.md and rules for Godot 4 (GDScript) and Phaser game jams: scope control, InputMap-only input, @export feel numbers, jam timeline, prompts for prototyping and polish.
- [Agent Builder Prompt Pack](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drawers) (DRW-03, $29): 10 production system-prompt templates for AI agents (PR reviewer, support triage, researcher, SQL analyst, docs Q&A and more), guardrail snippets, and 100 eval cases with a runner for any OpenAI-compatible API.
- [The Whole Cabinet](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drawers) (BUNDLE, $49): All 3 packs plus 12 months of updates. Saves $23.

## Free files
- [nextjs-supabase-rls.mdc](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/nextjs-supabase-rls.mdc): Cursor rule enforcing Supabase row-level security
- [godot-jam-timeline.md](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/godot-jam-timeline.md): 48-hour Godot jam timeline for agents
- [agent-guardrails.md](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/agent-guardrails.md): Guardrail snippets for any system prompt
